items.title: Exa boosts embedding throughput by 50% to index billions of documents on AWS AI chips
items.summary: Exa's neural search engine is backed by an in-house vector database, so the unit economics of embedding tens of billions of web documents drive the business. This post shares how Exa optimized embedding inference on AWS Neuron hardware (Inferentia2 and Trainium2) with custom NKI kernels, reaching a 47% gain in performance and cost per million documents.

items.title: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS
items.summary: Learn how to run two memory-bounded Kubernetes Pods on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU using open-source NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS. This walkthrough builds a custom Amazon Linux 2023 image, installs KAI Scheduler and the GPU Fractioning Operator, and validates per-Pod GPU-memory contracts with enforcement and metrics.
